headline: US launched HEAVY WAVE new strikes on Iran overnight (Qeshm, Bandar Abbas hit); MSFT +8% Azure +43%, META -8% capex; Dow worst day in 15mo on hawkish Warsh
client_frame: The pause is fully over. US launched sustained airstrikes on Iran overnight hitting IRGC command centers, missile facilities, and coastal defense in Iran's south — Qeshm Island, Bandar Abbas, Kish Island struck; Jordan intercepted 5 more Iranian missiles Thu AM; drone hit US-owned LNG at Egypt's Damietta. Oil spiked Wed (Brent $91, WTI $85) then eased Thu as QatarEnergy LNG completed first Hormuz transit since July 11 — physical flows continue despite the rhetoric. Fed HELD 3.50-3.75% (9-3, three hawkish dissents FOR hike); Chair Warsh delivered hawkish presser dropping forward guidance, emphasizing zero tolerance for above-target inflation; 30Y hit highest yield since 2007. Equities took it hard: Dow -1,153pts worst day in 15 months, SPX -1.52%, SOX -5.33% (fifth straight down, >$1T market cap wiped in a week). VIX finally cleared 20 (+13.5%). MSFT saved AH tape: rev $90B, Azure +43% accelerating, Copilot 30M paid seats, guiding Q1 Azure ~+45% — MSFT +8% premkt. META tanked -8% on Q3 guide (rev $61-64B below $63.15B consensus) + $130-145B capex range + $784M FCF collapse — the AI-capex-financing anxiety made real. AAPL + AMZN tonight AC: AWS ~28-33% is the whole ballgame after Azure set the bar. Today's tape open on MSFT-led relief but geopolitics + Fed dot plot next only Sept 15-16 = no policy relief for 6+ weeks. Client message: hedges through AC essential; if AWS disappoints against Azure bar, chip carnage extends and the equal-weight-vs-cap-weight rotation hardens.
